payload.name: Cracking Floor
payload.short: Cracked tiles give under every step, every turn spent standing and every blow; a crumbling tile caves in when its icon reaches the edge of the timeline, and whoever stands on it falls.

payload.name: Fire Trail
payload.short: Ember beasts leave burning ground behind them; it scorches whoever steps in or stands on it. Ice douses it, and it burns out on its own.

payload.name: Hold Barricades
payload.short: Every wave, the holds throw up barricades. Stand beside one to wear it down; when it falls, step onto the rubble to be Empowered.

payload.name: Ice Trail
payload.short: Frost beasts leave ice in their tracks; it slows whoever steps on it, and sometimes freezes them solid. Fire melts it.

payload.name: Land Mines
payload.short: Bulwark gunners plant mines as they march. Step on one, shove a foe onto it, or hit it from range and it arms: the blast lands on the timeline a moment later. A Disarm Kit pulls it safely.

payload.name: Shardfall
payload.short: Shards fall on the party: each strike shows on the timeline and its tiles light up before it lands. Where one lands it leaves a crystal; end a turn on it for a Ward.

payload.name: Slime Trail
payload.short: Slimes leave a sticky trail as they go; stepping in it slows you. Fire burns it away, and Purifying Salts wash it off.
